question: By what alternative procedures may installation or making be carried out?
premises: Installation may be done as before.
Making may be done in two ways.
inference: The installation or making may follow the earlier method or be done in two ways.
uncertainties: The compound kārayeddvividhā is transmitted as a single token.
plain_english: As before, one may install it, or one may make it in two ways; this is the accepted view.
